name: Gasthof Geierwallihof
beschreibung:
Located in the historic mountaineering village of Vent above 1,900 metres, Geierwallihof is an iconic haven for climbers and ski tourers. Cosy rooms and hearty Tyrolean fare refuel guests after high-altitude adventures.

The mighty Wildspitze, high trails, and the snow-sure ski area of Vent are right on the doorstep.
kurzbeschreibung: Gasthof Geierwallihof in Vent in the Oetztal offers high-alpine serenity at the base of 3,000-metre peaks.
